title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13

ai_review.summary: A smokin' show with flawless pacing and standout jams, captured in an unspecified but listenable source.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, highlighting tight transitions, strong renditions of Good Lovin', Black Peter, Hard to Handle, and a crisp St. Stephen > N.F.A. sequence. No recording‑quality issues are noted, suggesting the audio is clean enough for enjoyment despite the unknown source type.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews praise the musical performance highly and note no recording problems, leading to a high show rating with an assumed decent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on sound quality; no issues were reported, implying the recording is acceptable for listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Excellent pacing with smooth transitions between tunes; the set moves nicely from one song into the next.
